findings: Canonical pipeline never wired — PredictionService doesn't import or instantiate ModelOrchestrator, EnsembleIntegration, CalibrationIntegration, or ConfidenceIntegration. Production code path bypasses the entire canonical stack. Wire PredictionService.__init__() to create these components and replace generate_full_prediction() to call the orchestrator → ensemble → calibration → confidence flow.

FeatureSnapshot extraction not implemented — MatchFeatureSnapshot exists but extract_feature_snapshot() is never called. PredictionService still uses MatchFeatureExtractor.extract_features() returning a flat dict, bypassing the canonical snapshot. Replace feature extraction with extract_feature_snapshot() and pass MatchFeatureSnapshot to ModelOrchestrator.run_all().

Hardcoded confidence inputs — PredictionService.generate_full_prediction() line 757-760 calls confidence_engine.assess() with model_agreement=1.0, data_quality_score=0.7, and n_matches fabricated from feature dict keys. These are the exact placeholder values the spec forbids. Replace with orchestration_result.model_agreement, snapshot.data_quality_report.overall_score, and snapshot.home_form.matches_analyzed.

No reuse of PipelineResult — The spec requires "one pipeline execution result reused by prediction/markets/confidence/pick/analysis". PredictionService runs separate feature extraction for generate_prediction(), generate_prediction_markets(), detect_easy_match(), and build_analysis_context(). Create a PipelineResult dataclass containing snapshot, orchestration_result, ensemble_prediction, calibrated_prediction, confidence_assessment, and market_probs, then derive all downstream outputs from it.

Ensemble agreement not computed from models — EnsembleEngine._calculate_agreement() correctly computes 1 - (std_dev * 3) from model probabilities, but this is never surfaced because PredictionService doesn't call EnsembleIntegration.combine_predictions(). The hardcoded model_agreement=1.0 in line 757 bypasses real computation. Wire ensemble result's metadata["model_agreement"] into confidence assessment.

DataQualityEngine unused — data_quality.py and DataQualityEngine exist (imported in feature_snapshot.py), but PredictionService never instantiates or calls it. The snapshot's data_quality_report field stays None, so ConfidenceIntegration._extract defaults to 0.5 in line 552. Instantiate DataQualityEngine in PredictionService and populate snapshot.data_quality_report before orchestration.

Calibration never fitted — Calibrator1X2 in model_orchestrator.py wraps three IsotonicCalibration instances, but CalibrationIntegration.create_default() creates an unfitted calibrator and PredictionService never calls fit(). The calibrate_prediction() method falls back to uncalibrated probabilities. This is acceptable for Phase 1 (insufficient historical data) but the integration layer should expose is_fitted status in metadata so confidence assessment knows calibration isn't trained.

API backward compatibility untested — The spec requires "Keep existing prediction API contracts compatible" and "Do not break existing frontend consumers." Tests in test_api_matches.py verify the response structure, but no test confirms the new pipeline (once wired) produces the same JSON schema as the old Poisson-only path. Add a test comparing old vs new response schemas before deployment.
